scope: Exact Station pending-to-terminal before-launch race fix, seven boundary test methods, and finite Station-only installer. No deployment performed by reviewer.
checked_invariants: Only an observed pending to READY/FAILED/UNKNOWN guard cancellation with cancelled_before_launch proof can rearm.
Same job and generation, sending state, connected selected station, local and global enablement, and no uncertain outcome remain required.
Accepted states are not widened: stale pending speech never launches. Next tick rereads status and uses existing final nonce or failure delivery path.
Pause, disconnect, revoke, replacement/manual takeover, final-to-pending regression, and unknown launch outcome do not gain retry permission.
Installer changes only service.py plus two release paths in the pinned existing drop-in; no core unit, schema, credentials or settings changes.
Hardlinked base files remain byte-identical; changed service and manifest receive separate inodes; base manifest is reverified.
Installer retains common recovery lock, idle guards before and after stop, private backup, property equality, PID/cwd verification and rollback.

independent_local_validation.installer_probe_details: Executed exact installer AST with only filesystem constants, fixture hashes, SOURCE and command transport adapted. All systemctl calls intercepted. Verified old base bytes/manifests, hardlink separation, unchanged settings, drop-in mode0640, backup0600, success cwd and rollback cwd/config; no success receipt on rollback.
